description: The custom place types that YOUR tree uses for administrative units (the names are in the language of your tree). This copy is empty, so the types of Gramps itself are used, and a unit that Gramps has no type for (a canton, for example) is given the word of the answer as a custom type. To describe your tree: copy this file to ~/.config/placecompleter/type-conventions.json (or set PLACECOMPLETER_CONVENTIONS to a file) and fill it in; an update of the addon does not touch that copy. 'province', 'empire', 'monarchy': the custom type of your tree for them (empty: the type of Gramps itself); 'district' and 'settlements': custom types of your tree that are districts or settlements; 'rules': when the answer calls a level by one of 'words' (in any language, as the AI writes it) it is given the type 'string' (value 0 = custom). See type-conventions.example-he.json.
